title: Dutch intervention in Bali (1849)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Dutch intervention in Bali (1849)", at revision 1379538789, opens: "The Dutch intervention in Bali in 1849 was a major Dutch military intervention in Northern and Southern Bali, following two failed interventions, the 1846 intervention and the 1848 intervention. The Dutch used as a pretext Balinese salvage claims over shipwrecks, which were customary to the Balinese, but unacceptable under International law." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2661091, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military expedition in 1849". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
